v1.3.0 — CC payments (ONLINE BANKING TRANSFER) re-routed from Credit Card Charges to Credit Card Payments liability account; Purchase Interest re-routed from Credit Card Charges to Bank Fees; PAD CCRA re-routed from Exclude to Income Tax Expense; added new account IDs
v1.4.0 — CRA tax refund (Tax Refund + CANADA) re-routed from Exclude to Income Tax Expense; ATM Deposit re-routed from Exclude to Shareholder Loan (owner cash contribution)
v2.1.0 — Added confidence field to income_rules (high/medium/low) for auto-categorisation; HIGH patterns auto-classify without user review; generic tax refund and cashback re-routed to Exclude

version_history.note: Each rule has an entities[] array for entity filtering. The Get-IncomeClassification and Get-AccountIdFromRules scripts filter by EntitySlug. Account IDs are entity-specific — see the rule's account_id and cross-ref cloud-books-entities.json.
